name: Open Interface
description: Desktop app that completes tasks on macOS, Linux or Windows by sending screenshots to an LLM and simulating keyboard and mouse input.
whatItDoes: Lets a user type a request and have the computer carry it out across ordinary applications. It is a self-contained way to try full-computer control with a multimodal model.
howItWorks: The app sends the request with a current screenshot to the model, receives a list of input steps, performs them and then checks a fresh screenshot to correct course. It is distributed as a prebuilt binary and needs accessibility and screen-recording permissions on macOS.
models: GPT-4o, Gemini and other multimodal models
